TheLWord.se: The L Word · Lassoed
The girls have a hard time mixing with Tina's new conservative, straight friends. Bette ends up in a precarious position with her teaching assistant.
The L Word · Layup
Bette navigates the relationship with a potential donor. After a journalist's bad review leads to the failure of her book, Jenny seeks revenge.
The L Word · Lez Girls
The tryst between Bette and her T.A. threatens her new career. Tina discovers Angus with her nanny and Jenny publishes a story in "The New Yorker."
The L Word · Luck Be A Lady
Bette enjoys a secret new romance as she clashes with Tina. Meanwhile, Max fears discrimination at work. Helena, Shane, and Alice learn to play poker.
The L Word · Lesson Number One
Jenny's short story sparks interest from Hollywood. Helena struggles to pay back her $50,000 poker debt. Max faces more troubles at work.
The L Word · Lexington And Concord
Kit has a breakdown while on stage at The Planet, and unloads on the cheating Angus. Helena falls further into the depths of gambling.
The L Word · Lacy Lilting Lyrics
Tina and Jenny have creative differences over their movie. Alice and her friends console Leonard. Kit makes a crack in Papi's tough exterior.
The L Word · Little Boy Blue
Jenny and Tina find a director. Bette's control issues make an ugly appearance. Max makes a trip back to his hometown and Kit turns to alcohol.
The L Word · Literary License To Kill
Bette finds out that Jodi has been offered a job on the East Coast. Tasha is ordered by a commanding officer to keep her sexual orientation a secret.
The L Word · Long Time Coming
Alice struggles to accept Tasha's nearing deployment. Tina and Kate exclude Jenny from a meeting with executives. Max seeks surgery in San Francisco.
The L Word · LGB Tease
Following last season's events, Helena is jailed. Jenny schemes her way to directing the movie and The Planet hosts a coming-out party for Phyllis.
The L Word · Look Out, Here They Come!
While working, Shane gets to know a bridal party. Meanwhile, Helena is rescued by her cellmate and Tasha is under investigation by the U.S. Army.
The L Word · Lady Of The Lake
Shane gives up on sex and pours her energy in exercising. Tasha faces new allegations from her commanding officer. The Planet suffers a break in.
The L Word · Let's Get This Party Started
Tina and Jenny squabble over casting the lead role in Lez Girls. Meanwhile, the gang attends the opening of a hot new lesbian club, SheBar.
The L Word · Lookin' At You, Kid
Jenny throws a party for the girls to get to meet their movie counterparts—with mixed results. A rivalry launches between The Planet and SheBar.
The L Word · Lights! Camera! Action!
The production of Lez Girls faces troubles. Dawn and Cindi try to sabotage Kit's business. Meanwhile, Tina and Bette rekindle their passion.
